sourceText:
People Chow
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 27, 2009 - 12:07am

Ingredients




1/2 stk butter
1/2 cup Peanut butter
2 cups Powdered sugar
6 ounces Pk chocolate chips
6 cups Crispix cereal OR Corn Chex

Preparation

1 Mix butter, peanut butter and chips together in saucepan over med heat or melt in bowl in microwave. Pour over cereal in a lg bowl. Stir to coat. Put powdered sugar in a brown grocery bag and pour cereal into bag; shake to coat. Cut open bag to lay flat and spread out coated cereal. Sprinkle with extra sugar if necessary.
